name: Daphne
blurb: Daphne Music Player started as a showcase of the D programming language which uses the GTK4 graphics toolkit and the giD GObject Introspection bindings.
description:
Daphne Music Player started as a showcase of the D programming language which uses the GTK4 graphics toolkit and the giD GObject Introspection bindings.
It has since become a great music player, providing an intuitive interface organized into artists, albums, and songs.
A play queue provides a straightforward interface for manipulating playlists and the history keeps a record of played songs.
A spectrum visualizer shows audio playback with customizable colors.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
